# Mayfly Web Design

> Montana web design studio based in Missoula. Custom websites, AI automations, and SEO + GAIO (generative AI optimization) for Montana small and mid-sized businesses, serving Missoula, Bozeman, Great Falls, Billings, and statewide. Websites from $750; contact@mayflywebdesign.com.

Mayfly builds fast static websites (Astro, Cloudflare), automation workflows, and search visibility work for Montana businesses — outfitters, trades and home services, construction, hospitality, breweries, and professional practices.

## Services

- [Website Design](https://mayflywebdesign.com/services/website-design/): Custom, conversion-focused websites for Montana businesses.
- [AI Automations](https://mayflywebdesign.com/services/ai-automations/): Automated workflows for lead handling, follow-up, and operations.
- [SEO + GAIO](https://mayflywebdesign.com/services/seo-gaio/): Local search and AI-assistant visibility.
- [Pricing](https://mayflywebdesign.com/pricing/): Website, automation, and SEO packages with published prices.

## Work

- [Portfolio](https://mayflywebdesign.com/work/): Concept builds and shipped products.
- [Larkspur Construction Group](https://mayflywebdesign.com/work/larkspur-construction/): Concept site for a Bozeman general contractor, built around recruiting.
- [Ninebark Ranch](https://mayflywebdesign.com/work/ninebark-ranch/): Concept site for a Paradise Valley all-inclusive guest ranch.
- [Riverline](https://mayflywebdesign.com/work/riverline/): Shipped fly-fishing conditions platform with an AI guide (riverline.app).
- [Cairn](https://mayflywebdesign.com/work/cairn/): Shipped iOS app and MCP server that makes saved content retrievable by AI assistants.
